Honors students may need to enroll in elective coursework to meet University requirement of 120 credits.

MATH 201 will be waived with an ALEKS score of 80% or higher, or the completion of MATH 202 or equivalent. MATH 106 will be accepted as an alternative to MATH 201 for transfer students.

UCORE Inquiry and Complementary Fields of Study
Complementary Fields of Study (12 credits): Any courses with the [SSCI], or [HUM] designation (excluding courses in ACCTG, B A, B LAW, ENTRP, FIN, HBM, I BUS, MGMT, MGTOP, MIS, and MKTG), or courses in ANTH, AIS, ART, ASIA, ASTRONOM, BIOLOGY, CES, CHEM, CHINESE, COM, COMJOUR, COMSTRAT, CRM J, DTC, ECONS (excluding 101, 102, 198, and 327), ENGLISH (excluding 101, 105, 402, and 403), ENTOM, FOR LANG, FRENCH, FS, GERMAN, HISTORY (excluding 105 and 305), HONORS 270, 280, 370, 380, H D (excluding 205), HORT, HUMANITY, I D, ITALIAN, JAPANESE, KINES, LATIN, LND ARCH, MATH, MBIOS, MIL SCI, MUS, NEP, NEUROSCI, PHIL, PHYSICS, PL P, POL S, PSYCH, PUBHLTH, SHS, SOC, SOE, SOIL SCI, SPANISH, WGSS, and WRITE.

Management Electives [M]
Management Electives: A total of 9 credits including one [M] course are required. from the following: MGMT 415 or CES 207, MGMT 455, MGMT 456 [M], MGMT 483 [M], MGMT 487, MGMT 496, ENTRP 489, HBM 381 [M], HBM 494 [M], IBUS 453 [M], MIS 448, MKTG 495 [M].

Complete Carson Career Amplifier Program Tier 3

MGMT 450

International Experience Requirement or Electives
All students must complete the International Experience Requirement. Options for completing the requirement can be found in the Carson College of Business Academic Unit section of the catalog under Business. Students should consult with their advisor to determine the best option.

Management Electives
Management Electives: A total of 9 credits including one [M] course are required. from the following: MGMT 415 or CES 207, MGMT 455, MGMT 456 [M], MGMT 483 [M], MGMT 487, MGMT 496, ENTRP 489, HBM 381 [M], HBM 494 [M], IBUS 453 [M], MIS 448, MKTG 495 [M].

MGMT 491 [CAPS] or ENTRP 492 [CAPS]
All students must complete the International Experience Requirement. Options for completing the requirement can be found in the Carson College of Business Academic Unit section of the catalog under Business. Students should consult with their advisor to determine the best option.

Electives
Electives: 300- or 400-level coursework as needed to meet University requirements of 120 credits and 40 upper-division credits.

Complete Carson Career Amplifier Program Tier 4

The Management major has been developed for students interested in pursuing a career as a professional manager.  Students will learn vital management skills such as planning, organizing, leadership, and controlling.

Additional majors within the Business Administration Degree

Students already admitted to another major within the Business Administration degree, except for the Business Administration major, can elect to earn an additional major in Management by completing the following required courses: MGMT 401, MGMT 450, and MGMT 485, and three additional courses, including one Writing in the Major [M] course, selected from: MGMT 415 or CES 207, MGMT 455, 456 [M]. 483 [M], 487, 496; ENTRP 489; HBM 381 [M], 494 [M]; IBUS 453 [M]; MIS 448; and MKTG 495 [M]. None of the courses for an additional major may be used for a 300- or 400-level Business Elective and at least 15 credits of an additional major’s courses cannot be used elsewhere in the degree. If interested in this option, please contact a Carson College of Business advisor.

Graduation Requirements

To graduate with a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration with a major in Management, students are required to complete all admission and graduation requirements listed in the Carson College of Business (CCB) section of this  catalog and the coursework included in the sample 4-year plan listed below.
